name: BimOmni-30B-A3B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct thinker text_config (qwen3_omni_moe_text): 48 full attention layers, 32 query heads / 4 KV heads (GQA 8:1), head_dim 128. No hybrid or linear layers. Talker and code2wav branches removed from this checkpoint.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. A finetune (LoRA domain-adaptive pretraining, merged and unloaded) of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, not a new base model. It keeps the base's thinker text_config unchanged (48 layers, 2048 hidden, 32 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, 128 experts top-8) and the audio and vision towers frozen; the card states the Talker and speech output were removed and enable_audio_output is false, which is why this checkpoint holds 31.719B parameters against the base's 35.260B - a dropped output branch, not a quantisation. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other (card says apache-2.0 for the repo, HF tags report other), repo created 2026-08-12. Caveat: the knowledge probe is 60 four-choice items and the card calls it 'a small, project-specific knowledge probe'; the base was served at 4-bit MLX, so the 13.3-point overall gain is measured against a 4-bit base, not against bf16. Architecture fields were filled by hand during review: mk_finetune_record's arch_of() reads the top-level config.json, and Qwen3-Omni's is a wrapper whose text settings live under thinker_config.text_config, so the tool emitted num_layers null, kv heads 1, head_dim null and the sentence '0 full GQA layers'. The catalog's qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct base record has the same null fields - a pre-existing gap.
